title: Marshall, Chigorin, Albin & Baltic
intro: Refute 2...Nf6 with cxd5 and e4, meet 2...Nc6 with Nc3, avoid traps against 2...e5 with Nf3, and punish 2...Bf5 with cxd5 and Qa4+.
variation: d2d4 d7d5 c2c4 g8f6, d2d4 d7d5 c2c4 b8c6, d2d4 d7d5 c2c4 e7e5, d2d4 d7d5 c2c4 c8f5

lessons.title: Marshall (2...Nf6) & Chigorin (2...Nc6)
lessons.summary: Claim the centre with cxd5 and e4 against passive knight moves.

steps.text: The Marshall Defence (2...Nf6) neglects to support d5 with a pawn.
Trade off Black's d-pawn so you can build a huge centre.
steps.ifWrong: Play 3.cxd5: Black loses their central pawn.

steps.text: Seize the centre and chase the d5 knight.
steps.ifWrong: Play 4.e4 to drive the knight back and take full control of the centre.
steps.ifRight: White gets an ideal centre and fast development.

steps.text: In the Chigorin Defence (2...Nc6), Black puts the knight in front of the c-pawn.
Add pressure to d5 right away.
steps.hint: Develop your queen's knight to c3.
steps.ifWrong: Play 3.Nc3 to pressure d5 and prepare e4.
steps.ifRight: If Black plays 3...Nf6, 4.cxd5 Nxd5 5.e4 takes over the centre.

steps.hint: Take on d5 so 4...Nxd5 5.e4 wins space.
steps.ifWrong: Play 4.cxd5 (followed by 5.e4) to dominate the centre.
steps.ifRight: After 4...Nxd5 5.e4 Nxc3 6.bxc3, White has a massive pawn centre.

lessons.title: Albin Countergambit (2...e5)
lessons.summary: Accept the pawn and meet 3...d4 cleanly with 4.Nf3.

steps.text: The Albin Countergambit (2...e5) sacrifices a pawn to push ...d4 and create tactical traps.

steps.hint: Capture on e5 with your d-pawn.
steps.ifWrong: Play 3.dxe5: taking with the d-pawn avoids ...exd4 tricks.
steps.ifRight: Black will push 3...d4 to cramp your queenside.

steps.text: Develop your king's knight and avoid the Lasker Trap.
steps.hint: Put the knight on f3, attacking d4.
steps.ifRight: You stay a healthy pawn up and avoid every trap.

feedback.e2e3: 4.e3 walks into the Lasker Trap: 4...Bb4+ 5.Bd2 dxe3 6.Bxb4 exf2+.

steps.text: Fianchetto your bishop to target d4 and castle quickly.
steps.hint: Push the g-pawn one square to prepare Bg2.
steps.ifWrong: Play 5.g3 (or 5.a3 or 5.Nbd2): Bg2 puts immediate pressure on d4.
steps.ifRight: White keeps the extra pawn and enjoys a clear advantage.

lessons.title: Baltic Defence (2...Bf5)
lessons.summary: Meet 2...Bf5 with cxd5 and answer ...Bxb1 with Qa4+.

steps.text: In the Baltic Defence, Black plays 2...Bf5 right away, leaving b7 behind.
Open the c-file and win a central pawn if Black grabs on b1.
steps.ifWrong: Play 3.cxd5: if 3...Qxd5, 4.Nc3 gains a tempo; if 3...Bxb1, White has a sharp check.
steps.ifRight: Let us see how White answers 3...Bxb1.

steps.text: Black tries to win material with 3...Bxb1.
Deliver a queen check before taking on b1 so ...Qxd5 is impossible.
steps.ifWrong: Play 4.Qa4+: after Black blocks on c6 or d7, Rxb1 wins the bishop back while keeping the extra pawn.
steps.ifRight: A neat intermediate check that keeps White a full pawn up.

feedback.a1b1: 4.Rxb1 lets Black recapture 4...Qxd5, winning back the pawn cleanly.

steps.hint: Take the bishop on b1 with your rook.
steps.ifWrong: Play 5.Rxb1: White keeps the extra central pawn.
steps.ifRight: After 5...Qxd5 6.Nf3, White is a sound pawn up with a strong centre.
